Built a morning brief system.
Digital penguin runs it now.
7 AM. Every day. Without me.

Kanban board updates itself.
Story generator writes without me.

I'm slowly making myself unnecessary.

That's the point.

Build systems that outlive your attention span.

DRAFT 3 — The Hungary-to-Estonia Tax Math

Hungary: Earn $10K → Pay $4K tax → Keep $6K
Estonia: Earn $10K → Pay $2K tax → Reinvest $8K

Same work.
Different jurisdiction.
Double the runway.

People ask why I'm incorporating abroad.

I ask why they're paying 2x for the same privilege.
